title: Sources detail the Trump admin's heavy-handed intervention to aid Intel, including pushing it to expand local capacity and pressuring Apple to use Intel's fabs (Robbie Whelan/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Robbie Whelan / Wall Street Journal: Sources detail the Trump admin's heavy-handed intervention to aid Intel, including pushing it to expand local capacity and pressuring Apple to use Intel's fabs — The chip maker's business is improving, with government twisting the arms of potential customers and partners including Apple and Nvidia
